  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits Contract type: full-time or part-time Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home. Who The Client Is: Our company is a thriving real estate agency in Brisbaneâs south-west, with a principal who lists and sells at a strong pace, an in-house finance broker, and a loyal local client base built over many years. Appraisal requests are coming in fast, and the agency is ready to add a sharp, organised operator to keep every lead warm and every opportunity moving. Role Overview: Youâll sit at the centre of the agencyâs growth engine. Youâll own a database of 30,000+ contacts, keep it clean and organised, and run a consistent nurture program so past clients, buyers and potential sellers hear from us at the right time. Youâll be on the phones connecting with homeowners, qualifying appraisal leads and booking them in for the principal. Youâll also support marketing and bring practical AI and automation skills that make every follow-up faster and more reliable. Key Responsibilities:Â  Database & CRM ownership Clean, de-duplicate, update and segment approx. 25,000 existing contacts plus 5,000â10,000 newer buyer and seller contacts. Run a structured 6â12 month nurture cadence so every contact receives timely, relevant touchpoints. Log every call, email and outcome accurately so the CRM stays the single source of truth. Phones & lead nurturing Make value-led outbound calls: just listed, just sold, upcoming auctions in the street, and free market report offers. Nurture appraisal leads, qualify their timing and motivation, and book appraisals directly into the principalâs calendar. Hand over warm, ready-to-list clients with clear notes, and refer finance opportunities to the in-house broker. Marketing support Build and send email and SMS campaigns to targeted database segments. Prepare market updates and suburb reports that give homeowners genuine value. Support social media content and scheduling alongside the agencyâs existing marketing. AI & automation Set up automated follow-ups across SMS, email and CRM workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, or built-in CRM automation. Monitor automations for accuracy and tone, and refine them to lift response and booking rates. Additional sales administration Prepare sale contracts using approved templates and instructions; enter details, coordinate signing and distribute completed copies to relevant parties.Â  Prepare and process Form 6 appointment documents; check details and signatures, follow up outstanding items and file completed records, subject to principal review. Reception and general administration coverÂ  When the receptionist is away, answer and direct calls, respond to general enquiries, record messages, manage appointments and assist with routine administrative tasks. Required Skills and Qualifications: 2-3+ years in a sales admin, marketing admin or client-facing role, ideally within Australian real estate. Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, confident phone manner that Australian homeowners respond to. Hands-on CRM experience and a genuine love of clean, well-organised data. Â

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â

Â

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

What you'll work on

  • Website & digital: Update and maintain website content, event and campaign pages, and help keep everything accurate and up to date.

  • Events: Support conferences and events around the world â from registrations and exhibitor portals to materials, print orders, attendee lists and deadlines.

  • Content & campaigns: Support campaign execution by preparing content assets, landing pages, lists and other campaign elements.

  • Marketing coordination: Keep calendars, project pages, assets and plans organized, coordinate smaller deliverables and follow-ups, and help make sure the practical details don't fall between the cracks.

Who we're looking for

You are studying marketing, communications, business or a related field, ideally with at least one or two years of your studies remaining.

  • Work in a structured way and keep track of tasks and deadlines.

Copenhagen Optimization is the company behind Better Airport, our software platform built for intelligent airport operations.

Weâre looking for someone who wants to stay with us for the longer term, become part of the team and gradually take on more responsibility.

Interested?

Send us your application and CV and tell us a little about yourself, why this role interests you and what you think you'd bring to the team.

raw_payload.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

 

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson. Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development. XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be. We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility. Plus, our partner organizations Lightphone Mill IngredientAI   🔮 Who we’re looking for: We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design. Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs. Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages. Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms. Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance. Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives. The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations. We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!   🔑 Must-Have Competencies: We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us! 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals. Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js . Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion). Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe). Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen. Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows. Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code. Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.   💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies: Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI. Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations. Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times. WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``. Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT). Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.   💸 Compensation Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week. We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.   🎤 How we interview After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests. From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business. For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.   👩‍🏭 How we work: We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops: Transparency & Ownership : We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community. 150% Carbon Negative : Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021. Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative). Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time. Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process. Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio? → Read more on our Substack, over here , or our Medium, over there .   Important Reminders Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process. Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

jobs.description: You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply. A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing.  After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. As part of A·Team, you can expect: High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too.  Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.     How to apply: Go here:  https://build.a.team/remotivereferral  + mention Remotive.  We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. What you’ll do: Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team.  You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction.  Who A · Team is for: Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy. Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders. The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing Who A · Team is not for: People looking for small gigs Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet) Our long-term vision: A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams.  To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (USA - Boston, MA) PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform. We are seeking a technical and customer-focused Solutions Consultant to join our team . The Solutions Consultant will be responsible for understanding customer business environments, actively identifying potential roadblocks, and providing thoughtful solutions that leverage PagerDuty’s products . They will run the technical discovery process and provide guidance, relationship-building, and support throughout the sales process to ensure customer success . As a Solutions Consultant at PagerDuty, you’ll sit at the nexus between pre-sales, sales, and customer experience and success . You are an extraordinary partner who plays the part of consultant, technical salesperson, technical guru, product specialist, and teacher, with a committed dedication to exceptional customer service . You will build strong, significant, and compassionate relationships with internal and external partners at all levels while helping customers realize and optimize PagerDuty's capabilities . Key responsibilities Actively identify potential roadblocks and provide thoughtful, technical solutions Run technical discovery processes to understand customer environments and potential technical landmines Design integrations to provide seamless implementation with the customer's current technology stack Support sales cycles by handling technical questions in RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires Break down complex technical concepts and clearly articulate PagerDuty's business value to stakeholders from DevOps engineers up to C-level executives Support one of our over 375+ native integrations to help customers realize and optimize PagerDuty's capabilities Partner with sales, product, and cross-functional teams with a focus on growth and exceptional customer service Manage multiple tasks independently and collaboratively using project management and account management skills Come up to speed quickly, learn continuously, and apply impeccable attention to detail to all tasks Basic qualifications 5+ years of pre-sales experience Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in a technical field Ability to do basic scripting (Java, PHP, Ruby, Perl) and a fundamental knowledge of Linux Experience selling SaaS in a fierce environment Strong communication skills to build and manage relationships with new and existing clients, with a focus on growth Demonstrable knowledge of IT monitoring tools or IT Operations Excellent at multi-tasking, self-driven, and able to work both independently and with cross-functional teams Ability to travel to customer sites as necessary Preferred qualifications Understanding of monitoring systems such as New Relic, Nagios, Zenoss, Splunk, ServiceNow, and Zabbix Familiarity and knowledge of PagerDuty's space, or already being a fan of our product Experience in both enterprise and commercial sales PagerDuty is a flexible, hybrid workplace. We embrace and encourage in-person working as an integral part of our culture. Both our employees and external research tells us that co-located collaboration strengthens connections, drives innovation, and accelerates learning. The base salary range for this position is 144,000 - 197,200 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits. Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process. Hesitant to apply? We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts ! Where we work PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in: Location restrictions: Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role. How we work Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian. People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance. jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote United States BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio. The Role The Cloud Network Engineer extends BeyondTrust's on-premises networking fundamentals into AWS cloud networking, with a primary focus on architecting and operating FedRAMP-aligned environments. The successful candidate demonstrates strong technical judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to apply practical solutions to complex hybrid network engineering challenges, while serving as the primary liaison between the Network and Cloud Ops teams. What You’ll Do Operate and maintain BeyondTrust's on-premises and cloud network infrastructure, including routing/switching changes, datacenter resource changes, and routine firewall/security group changes end-to-end across on-prem and cloud environments; escalate complex or security-sensitive changes to the Sr. Engineer/SecOps. Design and implement AWS network architectures, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, and network security controls, aligned with FedRAMP, ISO 27001, and SOX requirements. Lead the CIDR range overlap remediation project by auditing existing on-prem and AWS CIDR allocations, designing a conflict-free addressing plan, and executing remediation/re-IP work with minimal disruption to production traffic. Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between the Network team and Cloud Ops on network design, shared infrastructure changes, and incident coordination. Mentor Network Administrators and Engineers on cloud networking fundamentals and hybrid connectivity best practices, extending networking expertise into AWS environments. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, contributing reusable modules to the team's shared automation library. Participate in the shared 24x7 on-call rotation, independently resolving Tier-1 and Tier-2 escalations, including cloud connectivity issues. Maintain network diagrams, CIDR/IPAM records, architecture documentation, and SOPs, and provide regular progress updates. Manage vendor relationships for cloud connectivity services, circuit vendors, and network infrastructure procurement and renewals. Work a hybrid or remote schedule depending on geographic proximity to a BeyondTrust office; travel to offices or datacenters as needed (5–10%). What You’ll Bring 3–5 years of total network administration/engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on AWS cloud networking work with VPC design, Transit Gateway, VPN/Direct Connect, Route 53, network security controls across hybrid environments. Demonstrated proficiency in Administrator/Engineer-level on-premises networking fundamentals. 3-5 hands-on experience with Cisco NX-OS/IOS/IOS-XE, Dell, and Palo Alto equipment. CCNA certification or equivalent hands-on experience Experience implementing and maintaining security controls aligned with industry frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC2, and FedRAMP. Strong documentation and organizational skills — demonstrated ability to produce clear network diagrams, IPAM records, and runbooks that hold up under audit. Strong analytical and cross-team communication skills; comfortable operating as a liaison between technical teams with different priorities. Nice To Have CCNP in progress, or equivalent Network Engineer-level experience. Experience with IPAM tooling such asNetBox, phpIPAM, Infoblox, BlueCat. Experience with Azure networking services and hybrid connectivity. Direct experience supporting a FedRAMP ATO or continuous monitoring (ConMon) process. Formal project management or technical project leadership experience. Proficiency in dynamic routing protocols (EIGRP, BGP) and in identity and access management services including RADIUS, TACACS+, Duo, Okta, and Cisco ISE. Better Together Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected. We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together. About Us BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders. BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners. Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com . #LI-BS1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beyondtrust-cloud-network-engineer

Marketing Technology, Data & Attribution

  • HubSpot instrumentation (and its integration with Salesforce): own lead management strategy, campaign orchestration and tracking, and stage definitions for the B2B funnel.

  • Dashboards: own the B2B analytics stack across CaliberMind, Looker, Data Studio, Salesforce, and GA4, and keep it accurate as definitions change.
  • FY planning support: partner with Strategic Finance and RevOps on fiscal year target-setting, run-rate projections, and scenario modeling for B2B pipeline and budget as well as org-level OKR setting.

Budget & Planning

  • Budget ownership: oversee the B2B marketing budget, including forecast, actuals, monthly reconciliation, and shifts across programs and months.
  • Vendor management: track spend and manage relationships with external vendors.
  • FY planning: lead annual and quarterly budgeting and planning for B2B Growth Marketing in partnership with Strategic Finance.

Marketing Website & CRO

  • Marketing website: manage the web team that owns navigation, landing pages, and on-page SEO/AEO for the Enterprise/B2B experience.
  • Testing and optimization: run a structured A/B testing and CRO program for B2B landing pages.
  • Accessibility: maintain WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across the B2B site experience.

    • People leadership: manage and develop a team covering marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization.
    • Process and tooling: set the team's operating rhythm and own its project management tooling (Asana and Jira).
    • Builds with AI: personally build AI-powered workflows for reporting, analysis, and campaign operations that enable the team to make better decisions and scale without additional headcount.
    • AI enablement: lead rollout of AI tools within B2B Growth Marketing, including data governance for tools connected to live CRM and marketing data, and set the team's judgment for where AI helps and where it doesn't.

The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.

What You'll Do

Relationship strategy and executive engagement

  • Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Client, practice and delivery team leads.
  • Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery
  • Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy. 

Platform integration and practitioner adoption

  • Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets
  • Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production
  • Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model

Pipeline and opportunity development

  • Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.
  • Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity
  • Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance

Telemetry and performance

  • Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins
  • Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress
  • Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them

What you will bring

  • 15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market
  • Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships
  • Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences
  • Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within. 
  • Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.
  • Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data & AI and Insights & Data practices
  • GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue
  • At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda
  • First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery
  • A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers  — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.

The Clover Home Care team is responsible for ensuring patients have access to the right care at the right time, in the right setting. We are a group of caring and passionate professionals dedicated to improving the lives of our most vulnerable members by providing in-home primary care, annual wellness visits, supportive care services, behavioral health and community services coordination. The Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist supports the daily scheduling and logistics of our growing field-based clinical workforce. This role manages provider availability, assignments, routes, and real-time schedule changes to ensure patients receive timely care and field teams operate efficiently. As a Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist, you will: Manage clinician schedules, profiles, availability, and service areas in CareLink. Coordinate scheduling and logistics across New Jersey. Optimize clinician routes based on geography, availability, and operational priorities. Identify and resolve scheduling errors, overbooking, unused capacity, and coverage gaps. Manage last-minute schedule changes caused by callouts, urgent requests, and field needs. Coordinate daily assignments for Nurse Practitioners and Medical Assistants. Support the PTO approval and schedule-update process in partnership with clinical managers. Respond to real-time scheduling questions and resolve scheduling-related concerns. Train new clinical team members and operational partners on CareLink workflows. Use approved AI and automation tools to streamline repetitive workflows, improve accuracy, and reduce manual work. Document processes and maintain cross-training to ensure consistent operational coverage. You should get in touch if: You have experience in scheduling, workforce coordination, field logistics, or healthcare operations. You currently live in New Jersey, previously lived there, or can demonstrate extensive knowledge of New Jersey geography, travel patterns, and regional differences. You have experience using AI or automation tools to improve business workflows. You are highly organized and can manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. You have strong attention to detail and can quickly identify and resolve operational issues. You communicate effectively with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams. We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

En nous concentrant sans relâche sur l'amélioration du bien-être financier de nos clients, nous développons des produits qui leur permettent de faire des économies et qui les soutiennent pour un meilleur avenir financier. Nous sommes soutenus par certains des meilleurs investisseurs dans le domaine de la technologie et avons été récemment valorisés à 7,3 milliards de dollars.

Nous sommes constamment reconnus pour notre culture de collaboration et d'inclusion. Plus récemment, nous avons été classés parmi les Premières entreprises fintech au monde par CNBC, Meilleurs lieux de travail par Built In, et par le San Francisco Business Times, Meilleurs lieux de travail d'Amérique par Newsweek, Meilleur employeur ''Startup'' par Forbes, et Employeurs les plus sains par Phoenix Business Journal.

Nous recherchons de nouveaux membres d'équipe qui sont enthousiastes à l'idée de concevoir et de proposer des produits nouveaux et meilleurs. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à bâtir un meilleur avenir financier pour des millions de personnes.

À propos du rôle

Un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA est responsable du cycle de vie complet des parcours que nos clients vivent avec l'agent IA d'Upgrade par clavardage, par téléphone et par courriel : création, optimisation, gestion des cas particuliers et augmentation du taux de résolution autonome. Cette personne conçoit des parcours dans les outils sans code de Sierra, collabore avec les groupes produits d'Upgrade pour intégrer leurs processus de service à l'agent, et répond de la capacité de l'agent à résoudre le problème du client de façon sécuritaire, exacte et sans intervention humaine.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA pour prendre en charge l'agent IA d'Upgrade destiné à la clientèle. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes de développement, de produit et des opérations clientèle. Vous transformerez des processus de service, comme effectuer un paiement, consulter les détails d'un prêt, mettre à jour une adresse ou activer les paiements préautorisés, en parcours de production, et vous continuerez à les améliorer après leur lancement.

Vous concevrez et gérerez les parcours de A à Z, de la première ébauche jusqu'à leur pleine maturité. Le travail est à la fois celui d'un bâtisseur et d'un analyste : concevoir le parcours, gérer les cas particuliers, lire les transcriptions et augmenter continuellement le taux de résolution autonome. Le taux de résolution autonome, la satisfaction client (CSAT), la qualité des transferts et le taux d'hallucination sont vos indicateurs clés. Au cours de votre première année, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille de parcours couvrant l'ensemble de nos produits (prêts personnels, carte, paiement différé (BNPL), marge de crédit hypothécaire (HELOC), dépôts) et contribuerez à établir les normes selon lesquelles Upgrade conçoit, teste et déploie ses expériences IA.

Nos technologies principales

Sierra Agent Studio (parcours sans code), simulations et analyse des conversations Sierra, API GraphQL et REST (comme outils de parcours), Genesys (transfert vers le centre de contact), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Claude et autres outils de LLM.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Création de parcours : Concevoir et développer des parcours Sierra dans Agent Studio pour le clavardage, la voix et le courriel, de la phase de découverte avec les opérations jusqu'au déploiement en production
  • Optimisation : Analyser chaque semaine les transcriptions, les enregistrements et les données analytiques, repérer où les conversations échouent ou sont transférées, et déployer des correctifs à la logique des parcours, aux instructions et à la base de connaissances
  • Gestion des cas particuliers : Cartographier les scénarios problématiques (paiements refusés, identité non concordante, comptes en souffrance, demandes non prises en charge) et s'assurer que chacun se conclut par une réponse exacte ou un transfert fluide
  • Résolution autonome : Assumer la responsabilité des cibles de résolution autonome et de CSAT pour chaque parcours, mener des déploiements progressifs (1 % → 100 %) et prioriser les travaux ayant le plus d'impact sur ces indicateurs
  • Partenariat produit : Collaborer avec les groupes produits (prêts personnels, carte, BNPL, dépôts) pour définir la portée de nouveaux parcours, maintenir les parcours à jour au fil de l'évolution des produits et définir les API dont l'agent a besoin
  • Sécurité et conformité : Appliquer l'authentification à plusieurs niveaux et la vérification renforcée, le libellé de conformité exact ainsi que des garde-fous contre les hallucinations et les réponses non conformes aux politiques
  • Transferts : Concevoir les transferts vers des agents humains dans Genesys avec des résumés exacts et le contexte d'authentification
  • Tests : Créer des suites de simulation et de tests de régression afin que chaque modification de parcours soit déployée avec la preuve qu'elle n'altère pas le comportement existant
  • Surveillance : Suivre la latence, les erreurs et les abandons dans SumoLogic et Grafana, et être responsable des alertes
  • Optimisation vocale : Latence, phrases de transition, interruptions, personnalité et ton
  • Relation avec Sierra : Agir à titre de responsable technique de notre côté, faire remonter les problèmes liés à la plateforme et orienter les demandes relatives à la feuille de route

Ce que nous recherchons

  • De 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ou une expérience équivalente dans des rôles en solutions techniques, en IA conversationnelle ou en gestion de produits techniques
  • Connaissance pratique du comportement des agents LLM : instructions, appels d'outils, récupération de connaissances, et les points de défaillance de chacun
  • Expérience dans la conception d'évaluations pour des systèmes non déterministes : jeux de tests, simulations, LLM évaluateur (LLM-as-judge), seuils de régression
  • Une maîtrise technique suffisante pour lire des spécifications d'API, collaborer avec des développeurs backend sur des intégrations REST et GraphQL, et raisonner sur les autorisations et les portées de permissions
  • Un esprit axé sur le produit et le client : vous comprenez les procédures opérationnelles, lisez les transcriptions, accordez de l'importance au ton et mesurez votre réussite selon la résolution du problème du client
  • Sens des responsabilités en production : déploiements, surveillance, analyse de journaux et réponse aux incidents
  • Rédaction claire et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs non techniques des équipes des opérations, de la conformité et des affaires juridiques

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Expérience pratique de Sierra Agent Studio ou d'une plateforme d'agents sans code comparable (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)
  • Expérience en IA vocale : reconnaissance vocale (speech-to-text), synthèse vocale (text-to-speech), optimisation de la latence, gestion des interruptions (barge-in)
  • Connaissance des systèmes de centre de contact tels que Genesys et de la conception de transferts vers des agents
  • Expérience en fintech ou dans un autre secteur réglementé (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)
  • Expérience en conception conversationnelle ou en rédaction UX

  • Assurances médicales, dentaires et de la vue payées par l'entreprise

  • Congé parental payé
  • Initiatives de santé et de bien-être

English language is required for this position, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.
